{{Top|leg|canon=Tally mark}}
'''Victory markers'''<ref name="CCG-RS1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 1}}</ref> were symbols painted on the side of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to represent the number of kills attributed to its [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Rogue Leader/Legends|leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] had a large number of victory markers on the side of his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] tallying [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starfighter and [[Ssi-ruu]]k [[Swarm-class battle droid|drone]] kills, bracketed on either side by representations of both of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]] he had faced.<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
